back-label.description: Accessible name of the full-screen Back button.

clear-label.description: Accessible name of the query clear button.

highlight.description: Emphasize literal, case-insensitive matches in suggestion titles.

label.description: Accessible name of the search landmark, input and full-screen dialog.

loading.description: Show a loading indicator while the host fetches suggestions.

loading-label.description: Accessible name of the loading indicator.

mode.description: View presentation. Auto uses a full-screen dialog below 600 CSS pixels.

name.description: Name under which the current query is included in form data.

open.description: Whether the search view is open. The field opens it on focus, click or input.

placeholder.description: Optional hint displayed inside the empty search field.

recent-label.description: Visible and accessible name of the recent-search group.

remove-recent-label.description: Accessible name template for recent-query removal. Use {value} for the query title.

suggestion-count-plural.description: Polite announcement for zero or multiple suggestions. Use {count} for the number.

suggestion-count-singular.description: Polite announcement when the list contains one suggestion.

suggestions-label.description: Accessible name of the suggestion listbox.

value.description: Current query. Edits and selected suggestions update this property.

--ki-density-control-offset.description: Added to the block size of every scaled control and row (button, icon button, field, select, textarea, option, list item, tab). Components floor the result at ki.size.target-min.

--ki-density-target-min.description: The smallest pointer target any density may produce: 24 x 24 CSS px by default and in compact (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), 44 x 44 in touch (WCAG 2.5.5). It floors a shrinking control but never lifts what a control paints: a control painted smaller extends its target to it, invisibly; rows and tabs grow to it (spec 045 A1).

--ki-focus-ring-color.description: Colour of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws: 3:1 or more against the page in every theme and scheme.

--ki-focus-ring-width.description: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws (its outline). One token instead of one per component, so a mode or a theme changes every ring at once.

--ki-glyph-size-md.description: Medium glyph for body content (20px at the default root size).

--ki-layout-spacing-3xl.description: The 3xl spacing step for a stack or grid gap.

--ki-layout-spacing-md.description: The md spacing step for a stack or grid gap.

--ki-layout-spacing-sm.description: The sm spacing step for a stack or grid gap.

--ki-layout-spacing-xl.description: The xl spacing step for a stack or grid gap.

--ki-layout-spacing-xs.description: The xs spacing step for a stack or grid gap.

--ki-search-bar-backdrop-filter.description: Complete backdrop filter for the bar.

--ki-search-bar-bg.description: Fill of the collapsed and docked bar.

--ki-search-bar-bg-image.description: Optional image painted over the bar fill.

--ki-search-bar-fg.description: Query ink over the search bar.

--ki-search-bar-height.description: Minimum height of the search bar, 56px at the default root size.

--ki-search-bar-placeholder.description: Placeholder ink exposed by the Search API.

--ki-search-bar-placeholder-fg.description: Default contrast pair for placeholder text over the search bar.

--ki-search-bar-radius.description: Pill corner of the collapsed and docked bar.

--ki-search-control-size.description: Base size of actions and minimum height of search rows.

--ki-search-group-heading-family.description: Font family for the recent-query group heading.

--ki-search-input-touch-size.description: Minimum input font size on coarse pointers to avoid focus zoom.

--ki-search-option-active-bg.description: Fill of the focused or hovered suggestion.

--ki-search-option-active-fg.description: Ink of the focused or hovered suggestion.

--ki-search-option-active-supporting-fg.description: Description ink on the focused or hovered suggestion.

--ki-search-view-backdrop-filter.description: Complete backdrop filter for the search view.

--ki-search-view-bg.description: Raised fill of the docked and full-screen view.

--ki-search-view-bg-image.description: Optional image painted over the view fill.

--ki-search-view-divider.description: Divider separating the active field and full-screen results.

--ki-search-view-shadow.description: Resting elevation of the docked view.

--ki-search-view-supporting-fg.description: Ink for descriptions and the recent-search group label.

--ki-typography-family-body.description: semantic font family for typography family body.

--ki-typography-size-body-1.description: semantic dimension for typography size body 1.

--ki-typography-size-body-2.description: semantic dimension for typography size body 2.

--ki-typography-size-caption-2.description: semantic dimension for typography size caption 2.

--ki-typography-visually-hidden-size.description: Nonzero edge for clipped text available to assistive technology.

--ki-typography-weight-body-bold.description: semantic font weight for typography weight body bold.

--ki-typography-weight-body-medium.description: semantic font weight for typography weight body medium.

component.description: A query field with a responsive view for suggestions, recent searches and results.

ki-clear.description: The user cleared the query with the clear control or with Escape.

ki-input.description: The current query after 200 ms of inactivity following an edit.

ki-remove-recent.description: The removed recent query. Hosts can use this to persist the updated history.

ki-search.description: The query to run, emitted on Enter or activation of a suggestion or recent search.

dialog-bar.description: Search bar inside the full-screen view.

input.description: Native query input in each presentation.

option.description: A selectable suggestion in the listbox.

view.description: Docked popover or full-screen dialog surface.

backLabel.description: Accessible name of the full-screen Back button.

clearLabel.description: Accessible name of the query clear button.

highlight.description: Emphasize literal, case-insensitive matches in suggestion titles.

label.description: Accessible name of the search landmark, input and full-screen dialog.

loading.description: Show a loading indicator while the host fetches suggestions.

loadingLabel.description: Accessible name of the loading indicator.

mode.description: View presentation. Auto uses a full-screen dialog below 600 CSS pixels.

name.description: Name under which the current query is included in form data.

open.description: Whether the search view is open. The field opens it on focus, click or input.

placeholder.description: Optional hint displayed inside the empty search field.

recentLabel.description: Visible and accessible name of the recent-search group.

removeRecentLabel.description: Accessible name template for recent-query removal. Use {value} for the query title.

suggestionCountPlural.description: Polite announcement for zero or multiple suggestions. Use {count} for the number.

suggestionCountSingular.description: Polite announcement when the list contains one suggestion.

suggestionsLabel.description: Accessible name of the suggestion listbox.

value.description: Current query. Edits and selected suggestions update this property.

slots.description: Direct ki-search-suggestion children supply suggestion and recent-query data.

leading.description: A control or decorative icon at the start of the collapsed or docked bar.

results.description: Host-rendered results beneath suggestions and recent searches.

trailing.description:
A control or avatar at the end of the collapsed or docked bar. Supply
a labelled button here to surface voice search.
